summary: Wix.com Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 earnings and disclosed the completion of a $1.6 billion modified tender offer in early April 2026, repurchasing approximately 30% of its outstanding shares. The tender was a capital return to shareholders, executed quickly and efficiently as part of the company's capital allocation plan. No specific price per share or premium was disclosed in the excerpt. The filing notes this as a modified Dutch auction tender. The deal effectively concentrated ownership and signaled management's confidence. Watch for potential EPS accretion and any subsequent trading patterns post-tender.
